nobox.final_span:
completely different types of animals for pets. Cats depend on teamwork while dogs rely on humans. Thus, it is only natural that humans find dogs attractive and cats overwhelmingly irresistible.
Another fascinating article in Very Interesting explored the differences between runners and walkers.
We all know that a runner and a walker are two entirely distinct animals, literally.
Walkers are slower, but more robust and less likely to belong to tribes. We might trace humanity's existence back to times when we were all walkers and likely needed to be to survive in a harsh world.
On the other hand, runners are graceful predators of the highest order. Skinny, extreme distance-covering types, they are the chilling descendants from our teenage years. We don’t have to be really, really fit if we want to run
